newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK FINMIN 13-WK T-BILL YIELD RISES TO 13.96PCT.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK FINMIN 13-WK T-BILL YIELD RISES TO 13.96PCT.

text.p: Average yield at an auction of Slovak Finance Ministry 13-week treasury bills rose to 13.964 percent from 8.453 percent in the last auction of similar bills in July, the central bank said on Wednesday.
It said bids submitted to the auction totalled 1.9 billion crowns, of which 800 billion worth were accepted. The ministry does not announce the amount of bills on offer at its auctions.
The statement added the maximum bid rate in the auction hit 14 percent, while the minimum bids were at 13 percent.
